Candidate if forced: Mineral King Sawtooth (NPS 36.453305,-118.596761; climber.org STOOTH 36.45301,-118.59694) or Rowell Meadow, unconfirmed. No second-pass page found naming a standard start; web search budget ran out.

A 2023 report started from Mosquito Flat (east side, camp near Mono Creek). Diversion Dam remains a valid alternative for a Hilgard Lake start.
